upstreamReview.runtimeDecision: stable runtime remains rc.2; the source-built alpha.1 release artifacts now pass an isolated 3091 composition/Web/Workspace/Session/Aezy-plugin gate, but preset and full parity gates still block promotion
upstreamReview.ownershipImpact: alpha.1 moves shipped Agent presets into the preset package with includeShippedRoot, renames code mode to ptc, adds durable preset/tool-change and model-selection projections, replaces ApiProxy with Remote gateway/controllers, splits the client runtime, adds Models provider-card slots, exact per-turn usage, configurable subagent models, experimental Agent Teams, packed Session transport, Web auth, SSRF-safe public WebFetch, and terminal/process fixes. Aezy now composes through the Remote/controller and split-client seams in the isolated runtime. The next owned gap is a real codex-app-server system preset with per-preset catalog filtering, Host execution gating, and persistent mode display; alpha.1 still does not provide those policies or a main-session Codex App Server backend.

releaseAvailability.runtimeBlockedReason: The official npm registry still has no @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.2-alpha.1. The isolated alpha composition gate is complete, but the preset slice and full M0-M4.2/Terminal/Security/Codex/self-development parity gates are not complete.
